feed.headline: Emotional reunions with loved ones for Oleshky evacuees

feed.headline: Egypt reopens Tripoli embassy after 12 years and raises concerns over Turkey-Libya maritime deal
feed.ai: Egypt is seeking closer ties with Libya’s western government after years of backing its eastern rival. Talks in Tripoli covered energy projects and Egypt’s objections to Libya’s maritime deal with Turkey.

feed.headline: Iran delivers secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes gas pipeline deal

feed.headline: Azerbaijan and Ukraine forge new energy defence and trade agreements
feed.ai: An Azerbaijani delegation led by its energy minister travelled to Ukraine to sign a 2026-2027 Action Plan. Bilateral talks focused on emergency winter grid equipment, joint manufacturing, and expanding European transit via the Trans-Balkan route.

feed.headline: Shock of rail tragedy gives way to sorrow and outrage in politically divided Spain
feed.ai: The latest train crash will pile pressure on the government of Pedro Sánchez, one month before the general election.

feed.headline: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
feed.ai: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.

feed.headline: Andy Burnham wants to get closer to the EU - but he shouldn't expect a smooth ride
feed.ai: Laura Kuenssberg talks to government insiders about the prime minister opening the conversation about the UK rejoining the EU.

feed.headline: Germans Miss Merkel, Their Old Chancellor, Though They Dislike Her Policies
feed.ai: Crowds have flocked to the stern, but reassuring, face of Angela Merkel in her official portrait, even as a backlash to her legacy roils German politics.

feed.headline: US President Donald Trump plans to meet Putin and Xi in China next week
feed.ai: US President Donald Trump said he would possibly meet with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping in China to discuss "denuclearisation" and how to end the Iran war.

feed.headline: Europe Still Sees Trump As Powerful, Especially in Foreign Policy
feed.ai: The commanding victory of the Democrats has brought private relief to some Europeans but no official glee, with Ukraine, Iran and NATO all hanging in the balance.

feed.headline: At least 21 dead after migrant boat capsizes off Senegal, authorities say
feed.ai: The United Nations' International Organization for Migration (IOM) says the dangerous Atlantic Route is a key pathway for West African migrants travelling to Europe.
